headline: Base Lines Shift on Two Busy Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, the sharpest alteration is in Weathered Expanse: returns now show six Warden, one Colonial and two neutral bases, against two, four and three respectively before. The region logged 50 events in 24 hours, six in the latest two, though casualty rates have cooled from preceding windows. Nevish Line remains busiest by event count, at 69, but reports none in the latest two hours; its balance is now six Warden and two Colonial bases, with none neutral, compared with one Colonial and one neutral before. Kuura Strand’s activity has eased to 22 events from 28 in the previous edition, with none in the latest two hours; five bases are Colonial-held and one neutral. Linn Mercy has edged from 11 to 13 daily events and recorded two in six hours. Marban Hollow has fallen from 28 to 15 and stayed event-free for six hours; Godcrofts likewise reports no events in that span. War 140 remains undecided, with 34 victory towns required.
